title: Unwanted Tenant Goes Crazy Then Calls Police And Gets Herself Arrested
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 19th, 2022. Officers responded to 9-11 call placed by a woman who claimed that someone was trying to attack her. When the officers spoke to her she behaved in strange manner and was saying that her boyfriend let a crackhead in the house because he was trying to sell drugs to her and she was trying to use a box cutter to attack her. Officers spoke to the boyfriend, and essentially told officers that she was crazy and she had some issues and she made up the story about the woman trying to attack her. The woman was instead his God sister who was helping him clean his house. He then stated that he had been trying to get her to leave his house but she wouldn't leave. He also mentioned that he filed an (Injunction) on her due to her committing felony battery on him in the past. A no contact order was then found in place due to that incident and she was arrested. This is the body cam footage of the events that followed.
